clue.text: Mini snapshot should be examined by contractors

parts.note: mini means small, as in a miniature version
a snapshot is a photograph, and a photographic copy is a print

explanation.surface: A tiny photo deserves close inspection by builders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contractors' are people signing contracts, who should read the clauses in tiny type, not builders.
explanation.definitionFit: The fine print of an agreement holds the conditions anyone signing a deal ought to read.

clue.text: Carriage sounds cheap

indicators.note: sounds says the word for cheap is spoken to give a word of the same sound

parts.note: a mean person is stingy or cheap

explanation.surface: A horse-drawn vehicle has a low-cost ring to it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carriage' suggests a coach; it means bearing or posture.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's carriage is their bearing or manner, the way they hold themselves.

clue.text: They put things on scales

parts.note: reads like people weighing goods, but describes those who lay down successive tiers or coatings

explanation.definitionFit: Strata or coatings set one upon another are tiers, like scales overlapping on a fish.

clue.text: After the wine I join the company in the porch

parts.note: port is a fortified wine from Portugal
Co is the usual abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: After drinks, I meet the firm's people in the entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: A colonnaded entrance porch at the front of a building is called a portico, from Italian.

clue.text: A preposition — one not out of order

parts.note: the Roman numeral I stands for one

indicators.note: out of order says the letters of the word not are to be arranged differently

explanation.surface: A grammar lesson about a word, and a batter who is still at the crease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of order' rearranges NOT into NTO, placed after I.
explanation.definitionFit: This word of direction, as in walking through a door, belongs to the class of prepositions.

clue.text: Score at cricket trial?

definitions.meaning: a run scored in a Test, an international cricket match
a trial run to see if something works

explanation.surface: Runs scored in a cricket match that serve as a trial.
explanation.definitionFit: A rehearsal or trial operation is a dry run; read literally it is a run scored in a Test match.

clue.text: Descriptive of the champion jockey in the saddle

definitions.meaning: the top rider shows the finest horsemanship

explanation.surface: Words for the leading jockey mounted on his horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Split, the word says the finest horsemanship; whole, it means sitting with legs either side of a mount.

clue.text: A girl who is tender to domestic animals

definitions.text: A girl who is tender to domestic animals

parts.words: A girl who is tender to domestic animals
parts.note: reads like a kind young woman, but tender means one who tends, looking after dogs

explanation.definitionFit: A young woman employed to look after dogs at boarding premises tends to them.

clue.text: Measure encountered to the East

parts.note: to have encountered someone is to have met them
E is the standard abbreviation for East on a compass

explanation.surface: A measurement made after meeting eastward.
explanation.definitionFit: To mete is an old verb meaning to allot or deal out by measure.

clue.text: Dries and dyes thread in production

indicators.note: being put into production suggests the letters are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A textile mill dries and dyes its yarn as it is made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in production' rearranges the ten letters of DYES THREAD.
explanation.definitionFit: To dehydrate something is to remove its water, which is drying it out.

clue.text: Jack Brown is popular in Scotland

parts.note: a jack tar, or simply tar, is an old word for a sailor
tan is a light brown colour

explanation.surface: Someone called Jack Brown is well liked north of the border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jack Brown' reads as a man's name; it is two separate words for sailor and a colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Checked woollen cloth in clan patterns is famously worn and loved across Scotland.

clue.text: Commanding Officer's to dismiss a cavalryman

parts.note: CO is the military abbreviation for Commanding Officer, with the possessive S
to dismiss someone from a job is to sack them

explanation.surface: A commander intends to discharge one of his mounted soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Cossacks were Russian and Ukrainian horsemen famed as light cavalry.

clue.text: It's cold in the country-you need a fur

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: China is a country in East Asia
a chill is a coldness

explanation.surface: It's freezing out here; you will want a fur coat.
explanation.definitionFit: Chinchilla pelts from the South American rodent are a prized soft fur.

clue.text: He's in no hurry to take over

definitions.text: He's in no hurry to take over

parts.words: He's in no hurry to take over
parts.note: reads like a reluctant successor, but in cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled, taken by a bowler of gentle pace

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is six balls delivered by one bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: A spin or medium-pace bowler delivers the ball unhurriedly in cricket.

clue.text: Lowered oneself?

parts.note: reads like stooping to something shameful, but describes going down onto the knees

explanation.definitionFit: Going down on bended knee physically lowers the body.

clue.text: Watch from the shadows

parts.note: reads like spying while hidden, but describes a timepiece that tells the hour from a cast shadow

explanation.definitionFit: A garden dial shows the time by the shadow its gnomon throws, so it is a clock read from shade.

clue.text: Describing a boom in restored icons

indicators.note: restored says the word icons is put back together in another order

explanation.surface: Talking about a surge in renovated religious images.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Describing a boom' suggests an economic surge; it is the sound barrier boom.
explanation.definitionFit: A supersonic aircraft makes a bang relating to sound waves, so the adjective is acoustic.

clue.text: Vegetable has one on both sides

indicators.note: on both sides says the two copies flank the other piece, one either side
both says the word on is taken twice

parts.note: the word on is used as written
the Roman numeral I stands for one

explanation.surface: A vegetable that comes with one on each side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'both' doubles ON, and 'sides' puts the I (one) between the two copies.
explanation.definitionFit: The onion is a bulb vegetable used in cooking all over the world.

clue.text: Some said Olivier was a matinee one

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: People claimed the actor Laurence Olivier was a heart-throb of afternoon performances.
explanation.definitionFit: A matinee idol is a handsome actor adored by audiences, so Olivier was such a heart-throb.

clue.text: A travel authority

parts.note: reads like a tourism body or a travel expert, but means a document authorising entry to a country

explanation.definitionFit: The stamp or permit in a passport gives a traveller official permission to enter a foreign state.

clue.text: Form a queue at the back

definitions.text: Form a queue at the back

parts.words: Form a queue at the back
parts.note: reads like joining the end of a line, but a queue is also an old word for a pigtail worn at the back of the head

explanation.definitionFit: To braid hair into a pigtail is to make one, so forming a queue means weaving strands together.

clue.text: Undecided as yet, but it could mean a quiet conclusion

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
an ending is a conclusion

explanation.surface: Still unsettled, though it might signal a calm finish.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter awaiting a decision is unresolved, still to be settled.

clue.text: Down-trodden machine-worker

parts.note: reads like an oppressed factory hand, but describes a foot pedal literally trodden down to drive a machine

explanation.definitionFit: A foot-operated lever drives old sewing machines and lathes when pressed by the foot.

clue.text: Film show

definitions.meaning: the 1972 musical film starring Liza Minnelli
a nightclub entertainment of song and dance

explanation.surface: Nothing more than a film screening.
explanation.definitionFit: One title names a famous Minnelli musical movie, and the word also means nightclub entertainment.

clue.text: Made oneself fearfully small

parts.note: reads like shrinking in size, but describes shrinking back or cowering in fear

explanation.definitionFit: To cower is to draw back and crouch in fear, making the body seem smaller.

clue.text: Announcement given when leaving work

definitions.meaning: a warning to an employer of resignation

explanation.surface: A statement made by someone quitting their job.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a public announcement and the formal warning an employee hands in before quitting.

clue.text: In part of a hospital-mental, perhaps

parts.note: a ward is a room or section of a hospital for patients

explanation.surface: Being on a hospital ward, possibly a psychiatric one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mental' looks like a type of ward; it is the definition, meaning of the mind.
explanation.definitionFit: Mental life is internal, so the adjective for things within the mind is an example of the word.

clue.text: A number to sing in the choir

definitions.text: A number to sing in the choir

parts.words: A number to sing in the choir
parts.note: reads like a song in the repertoire, but a number of singers in a choir make up one voice part

explanation.definitionFit: The low female or high male voice part is one of the parts sung in a choir.

clue.text: Bring up, or what you may bring up

definitions.meaning: the back end, as in bringing up the hindmost position

explanation.surface: Raise, or something you might raise.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise a family is to rear it, and one brings up the back of a procession.

clue.text: Unwise profession of medical consultant

definitions.meaning: a doctor's job is to counsel sick patients, giving advice to the unwell

explanation.surface: A medical specialist's job is a foolish one.
explanation.definitionFit: Poorly judged means imprudent; split, the word describes counsel given to sick people, a doctor's occupation.

clue.text: Grounds or pastures, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word for pastures is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: leas are grassy meadows or pastures

explanation.surface: A choice between areas of land or grazing fields.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grounds' looks like land; it is coffee grounds, the sediment.
explanation.definitionFit: Dregs at the bottom of wine or coffee are its sediment, also called grounds.

clue.text: Fruit avoided by lovers?

definitions.meaning: a sour green berry grown on a thorny bush
a courting couple shuns an unwanted third person tagging along

explanation.surface: Fruit that courting couples steer clear of.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a hairy green berry and, idiomatically, the awkward third party with a couple.
